rho_reference.method: negation-map r-adding walk: look-ahead, short-cycle escape by doubling, distinguished points, stride starts

rho_reference_rule: Koblitz curve: the signed-Frobenius walk (A = 2n) and the negation walk (A = 2) on the same seeds; the lower mean S prices the column, the other is kept in rho_reference_candidates

what_this_is: Index-calculus configurations -- each a choice of factor base, target source, decomposition oracle, polynomial solver and relation matrix -- run end to end against a planted logarithm, with counted phase costs in group-addition equivalents divided by sqrt(r); consult cost_qualification for unpriced work.
what_this_is_not: not a speed claim: a configuration on a known-answer instance is a measurement, and a comparison needs the matched reference rows AGENTS.md section 1 asks for
not a wall-clock benchmark: operation counts are the metric, wall time rides along
not a claim about any deployed curve
